S1-LL18-b:moved-keys.distinct_eq_keys: Forty distinct native and target conses with equal contents; cycles and table-as-key checked separately.
S1-LL18-b:moved-keys.cached_lookup: Every trace round leaves a live cache, then collects before replacement. Separate cached replacement/deletion case requires the bucket index to change.
S1-LL18-b:moved-keys.real_movement: Execution records retain before/after root addresses at low and above-2-GiB placements. Retired semispaces are poisoned before subsequent use; generated collection leaf poisons before returning.
S1-LL18-b:moved-keys.semantics: Native CCL supplies every trace result and both generated moving-form results. Lookup values/presence, defaults, replacement counts, deletion and repeated collections are compared exactly.
S1-LL18-b:moved-keys.mutants: Collector key notification/parity and cached-root omissions, runtime rehash/cache/count omissions, and B adapter delivery faults rerun the actual execution harness.
S1-LL18-b:moved-keys.compiler: Accepted compiler rebuilt unchanged in disposable U1; compiler R6/R6a reused by exact hash. WAT, Wasm, compiler FASL and bytes actually installed are retained.
S1-LL18-b:moved-keys.scope: scope.json records representation, algorithm replacement and deferred CL surface/owner installation responsibilities.
